title: Mourning Turned Into Joy
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler who stays close until sad feelings soften, and tonight Heavenly Father promises people who had been sad for a long time that He will turn their mourning into joy, the way Willow sits on the curb beside her brother and shares her spoon until they are both giggling.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she stays close until sad feelings soften. In Willow’s world today: her brother drops his ice cream, and his whole face crumples. Willow does not laugh. She sits beside him on the curb and hands him her own spoon, and soon they are both giggling. Just like Heavenly Father turning mourning into joy, Willow learned that comfort helps a sad thing become a glad one.
